The '''Perlemian Orbital Facility''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] around [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It hosted gatherings where candidates for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] met with campaign advisors, lobbyists, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]].

It was here that [[Lorn Pavan]] gave [[Hath Monchar]]'s [[Datacron/Legends|data holocron]] to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], after being pursued by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].
